name: RAR payment_initiation
description: A payment needs a person PingFederate authenticated and an amount of at most 1000, and an agent may only initiate it. A request for initiate alone is permitted; one that asks for initiate and other actions is narrowed to initiate; any other action list, a larger amount or no authenticated person is denied.

rules.name: narrow to initiate
rules.description: An agent may initiate a payment for the person; cancelling one, or anything else, is the person's.

rules.name: permit a person's payment up to 1000
